This 2019 Subaru Ascent Touring delivers the three-row capability and refined features you need for your family's everyday adventures and weekend getaways.

- Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with perforated leather trim
- Three-row seating with bench third-row seats
- Memory driver seat and power driver seat for customized comfort
- Panoramic moonroof
- 20-inch alloy wheels
- Heated rear seats
- Power liftgate
- Heated steering wheel

The Touring trim equips you with sophisticated comfort features that make longer drives enjoyable. The heated and ventilated front seats maintain your preferred temperature throughout the year, while the heated rear seats keep passengers comfortable in cold weather. The panoramic moonroof opens up your driving experience, flooding the cabin with natural light. Leather-trimmed upholstery adds a premium feel to every journey, and the memory driver seat ensures your position adjusts automatically each time you settle in.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamless with the STARLINK multimedia system's 8-inch touchscreen. You can access navigation, control your music through SiriusXM satellite radio and standard AM/FM radio, or connect your smartphone via Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. Steering wheel-mounted controls keep your attention on the road while you manage your audio experience.

Safety and confidence come standard with this three-row crossover. Electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system protect your occupants. The exterior parking camera assists when reversing, and STARLINK Safety and Security provides emergency communication when you need it. Auto high-beam headlights adapt to oncoming traffic, while rain-sensing wipers activate automatically.

The 2.4-liter DOHC engine paired with Lineartronic CVT and all-wheel drive delivers capable performance with fuel efficiency at 20 city and 26 highway miles per gallon. All-wheel drive with four-wheel independent suspension provides confident handling in varied driving conditions, and the roof rack rails offer convenient storage options for your gear.

This 2019 Ascent Touring combines practicality with comfort for families who refuse to compromise on either. Three rows of seating, premium materials, and thoughtful technology features make this crossover ready for whatever comes your way. Schedule your visit to see how this vehicle fits your lifestyle.

Connectivity is seamless with multiple USB charging ports, voice recognition through SYNC 3, and the ability to stream music through SiriusXM Radio or personal devices via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The 110V AC power outlet lets you charge personal electronics on the go.

The blue exterior presents a clean, professional appearance, and body-color bumpers along with turn signal indicator mirrors complete the cohesive look. This EcoSport is equipped to handle your daily demands with reliability and modern conveniences you'll appreciate every time you drive.

Contact us to schedule a test drive and discover how this 2019 Ford EcoSport SE can serve your transportation needs.

This Tucson Sport comes with a solid service history and has been owned by just two previous owners, offering peace of mind as you consider this vehicle for your next purchase. We invite you to schedule a test drive and see firsthand how this crossover can fit your lifestyle.

- Rear Backup Camera
- SE Convenience Package

The six-speed automatic transmission handles acceleration smoothly across varied driving conditions.

The 8" touchscreen with voice recognition provides easy access to navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls. With FordPass Connect, you gain remote vehicle access through your smartphone, allowing you to lock, unlock, and locate your EcoSport from virtually anywhere.

Safety and convenience work together throughout this vehicle. Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, while Cross-Traffic Alert provides added confidence when backing out of parking spaces. The rear backup camera gives you a clear view of obstacles behind you, and heated front seats provide comfort during cooler months. Dual front impact airbags, side curtain airbags, and knee airbags create multiple layers of occupant protection.

Your entertainment options extend far beyond standard radio thanks to the included five-year SiriusXM subscription, offering access to hundreds of channels. The seven-speaker system delivers quality sound for your favorite music and content. A 110V power outlet lets you charge devices on the go, while dual smart-charging USB ports keep smartphones and tablets ready for use.

- Apple CarPlay

Step inside to discover a premium interior wrapped in leather with sport seats designed for comfort and support. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the piano black interior surfaces and MINI Yours leather steering wheel elevate the driving environment. The 1.5L three-cylinder engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive performance, achieving 24 miles per galgallon in city driving and 32 on the highway. Steptronic transmission capability allows for a more engaging driving experience when desired. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides excellent handling characteristics suitable for everyday driving.

Technology integration sets this Countryman apart. Apple CarPlay connectivity keeps you linked to your smartphone, while the touchscreen navigation system with advanced real-time traffic information ensures efficient routing. The harman/kardon premium sound system with Logic 7 digital surround creates an immersive audio experience, enhanced further with SiriusXM satellite radio and wireless charging for compatible devices. MINI Assist eCall, remote services, and MINI Connected XL provide comprehensive vehicle management tools.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. The active driving assistant, electronic stability control, ABS braking system, and traction control work together to provide confidence on every journey. As a non-smoker vehicle maintained by a single owner, this Cooper Countryman represents a clean, reliable choice ready for its next owner.

Hudson Valley drivers searching for a refined, feature-loaded crossover have a compelling option waiting at Thruway Nissan in Newburgh, NY. This 2019 Nissan Rogue SL arrives in a head-turning Orange Metallic exterior paired with an Almond leather interior, bringing a distinctive presence to the Route 17K and I-84 corridor. With all-wheel drive, a smooth CVT with Xtronic transmission, and a well-appointed SL trim, this Rogue delivers the kind of versatile performance that suits everything from daily commutes across the Hudson Valley to weekend escapes into the Catskills.

Inside, the Rogue SL surrounds you with premium comfort and convenience at every turn. Heated front bucket seats wrapped in leather-appointed trim keep you comfortable through New York winters, while a heated steering wheel means your hands stay warm from the moment you set off. A memory seat ensures your preferred driving position is always ready, and both the driver and passenger benefit from power-adjustable seating. Dual-zone automatic temperature control lets driver and front passenger dial in their ideal climate independently, and the power liftgate adds a practical touch when your hands are full. Roof rack rails round out the utility story, making this SL ready for gear, adventure, or the everyday demands of Hudson Valley life.

Technology and connectivity are where this Rogue SL truly distinguishes itself. The NissanConnect system with Navigation and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you linked to maps, music, and messages with ease. A premium Bose audio system with 9 speakers fills the cabin with rich, detailed sound, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio and an AM/FM/CD/AUX setup for maximum versatility. An auto-dimming rearview mirror, Homelink, and steering wheel-mounted controls round out the interior tech package. Safety is equally well covered, with Blind Spot Warning and Rear Parking Sensors adding meaningful driver assistance on busy roads and tight parking situations. Auto high-beam headlights, front fog lights, and an emergency communication system through NissanConnect Services provide additional layers of confidence behind the wheel. The Rogue rides on 19-inch aluminum alloy wheels and benefits from four-wheel independent suspension for a composed, comfortable ride across varying road surfaces.

description:
This 2019 Buick Encore Essence is a capable compact crossover that delivers practical everyday performance in a refined package.

- 1.4L Turbocharged I-4 Engine with 153 hp and 177 lb-ft of torque
- All-Wheel Drive
- 6-Speed Automatic Transmission with Overdrive
- Heated Front Seats
- Leather-Appointed Seat Trim
- Power Driver Seat with Memory
- 6-Way Power Adjustable Front Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front Zones
- Rear Parking Camera
- 18-Inch Alloy Wheels
- Electronic Stability and Traction Control

The turbocharged engine provides responsive acceleration when you need it, while maintaining respectable efficiency ratings of 25 mpg city and 30 mpg highway. The six-speed automatic transmission handles daily driving with smooth shifts, and all-wheel drive gives you confidence in varying weather conditions.

Inside, you'll find a well-designed interior that balances comfort with functionality. Heated front seats provide warmth during cold months, and the leather-appointed trim adds a touch of refinement. The heated steering wheel is another welcome feature for winter driving. Dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger can set their preferred comfort levels independently.

Technology features keep you connected without distraction. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration lets you access your smartphone's key functions through the Buick Infotainment System, while SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options. The rear parking camera takes guesswork out of backing up in tight spaces.

Safety has been prioritized with multiple airbags throughout the cabin, including front, side, and overhead coverage. Electronic stability and traction control systems work to maintain vehicle control in challenging driving situations. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power, and a low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed.

At 17,908 miles, this Encore Essence represents an excellent opportunity to own a well-equipped crossover that's ready for years of dependable service. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle's balanced blend of comfort, capability, and value.

This 2016 Jeep Cherokee Trailhawk delivers the capability and refinement you need for both everyday driving and adventure. Built on the Trailhawk platform, this red Cherokee combines off-road readiness with comprehensive modern conveniences for a vehicle that adapts to your lifestyle.

- Blind Spot & Cross Path Detection
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist System with ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go
- Lane Departure Warning Plus with Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
- Auto High Beam Headlamp Control
- Parallel & Perpendicular Park Assist with Stop
- Power Heated Mirrors with Exterior Heating Elements and Windshield Wiper De-Icer
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel

- Uconnect 8.4 Navigation System with GPS

The 3.2L V6 engine with enhanced Stop-Start technology delivers 19 city and 26 highway MPG with a 9-speed automatic transmission. Four-wheel drive with off-road suspension ensures confident handling across varied terrain, while the independent four-wheel suspension provides a composed ride on any surface. The Trailhawk's capability is matched by thoughtful engineering, including an auxiliary transmission oil cooler and engine block heater for durability in demanding conditions.

Inside, premium leather-trimmed bucket seats with heating and ventilation provide comfort through extended drives. Dual-zone automatic temperature control with a humidity sensor maintains your preferred climate, while the power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support accommodates drivers of all sizes. The Uconnect 8.4 touchscreen navigation system with GPS guides your journeys, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio and voice command integration through Bluetooth.

Safety systems reflect Jeep's commitment to protection. Adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go capability reduces fatigue on highways, while advanced collision warning and mitigation systems provide additional security. The comprehensive airbag design, including knee and overhead airbags, works alongside electronic stability control and traction management to keep you secure.

Practical features enhance daily usefulness. The Class III receiver hitch with wiring harness and Jeep rack off-road accessory kit support your gear and adventures. The tonneau cover protects cargo, while the remote start system and universal garage door opener add convenience to routine tasks. Roof racks with rails accommodate additional storage and carrying capacity.

This 2016 Cherokee Trailhawk represents a well-equipped vehicle ready to meet your demands whether navigating city streets or exploring beyond them. Visit us to examine its condition and take it on a test drive to experience its balanced combination of capability, safety, and convenience firsthand.

This well-maintained 2016 GMC Terrain SLE-1 offers practical capability and dependable performance in a versatile compact SUV package.

- 2.4L 4-Cylinder SIDI DOHC VVT engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- All-Wheel Drive for enhanced traction and stability
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with AM/FM radio and color touch stereo
- Bluetooth® connectivity for phone integration
- 8-way power driver seat with telescoping steering wheel
- Rear backup camera for convenient parking and reversing
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Front bucket seats with split-folding rear seat
- Premium cloth seat trim with rear seat center armrest
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Comprehensive airbag system including front and side protection

This Terrain delivers solid fuel economy with EPA ratings of 20 city and 29 highway miles per gallon, making it an efficient choice for both daily commuting and weekend adventures. The 2.4L four-cylinder engine balances capability with reasonable fuel consumption, while the AWD system provides confident handling in various weather conditions. With 58,881 miles on the odometer, this vehicle represents a relatively low-mileage entry into GMC ownership.

The cabin combines comfort and convenience features that enhance your driving experience. Power windows, power door mirrors, and remote keyless entry provide modern accessibility, while the heated door mirrors assist during cold weather months. The auto-dimming rearview mirror reduces glare on evening drives, and the outside temperature display keeps you informed of changing conditions.

Safety receives thoughtful attention throughout the design. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power, while the comprehensive airbag system, including overhead protection, works alongside Electronic Stability Control to help keep occupants secure. The low tire pressure warning system alerts you to maintenance needs before they become problematic.

The split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for transporting both passengers and cargo, adapting to your needs whether you're running errands or planning a getaway. The rear backup camera makes parking and reversing straightforward and safe, particularly valuable in tight spaces.

This 2016 GMC Terrain SLE-1 is ready for ownership and use. We welcome you to visit our showroom to inspect this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive.

This 2016 Volvo XC60 T5 Drive-E Platinum in Crystal White Pearl represents a refined choice for drivers seeking sophistication and reliability in a mid-size luxury SUV.

- Linear Walnut Wood Inlay

- Power Moonroof

This Volvo combines Scandinavian design principles with practical engineering. The Drive-E 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder engine delivers responsive performance while maintaining efficiency, achieving 23 mpg in city driving and 31 mpg on the highway. The front-wheel drive platform provides confident handling on various road conditions, and the automatic transmission with Geartronic offers both convenience and control when desired.

The interior welcomes you with leather seating surfaces and linear walnut wood inlay accents that establish an upscale atmosphere. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the dual-zone automatic climate control ensures comfort for all occupants. Technology integration is straightforward and functional. The Sensus Navigation system with Mapcare provides reliable route guidance, while the harman/kardon® premium audio system with twelve speakers delivers clear sound for music, podcasts, or SiriusXM satellite radio. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention on the road, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenience to everyday driving.

Safety features reflect Volvo's commitment to occupant protection. The Blind Spot Information System (BLIS) Package uses sensors to monitor adjacent lanes, providing alerts and cross-traffic assistance during lane changes. Front and rear park assist sensors help you navigate tight spaces confidently, while the exterior parking camera gives you a clear rear view when reversing. The vehicle is equipped with dual front and side impact airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and electronic stability control to provide comprehensive protection.

Practical features enhance daily usability. The power liftgate opens with the press of a button, the split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility, and the roof rack rails accommodate carrying solutions. Xenon headlights with automatic operation and cleaning function ensure clear visibility in various weather conditions, while rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to precipitation intensity.

This 2016 XC60 T5 Drive-E Platinum offers the combination of luxury amenities, safety technology, and reliable performance that defines the Volvo ownership experience. We invite you to schedule a viewing and test drive to discover how this vehicle meets your transportation needs.

This 2016 Ford Escape S offers practicality and reliability in a well-equipped compact SUV that meets the needs of today's drivers.

- SYNC Communications & Entertainment System
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Fully Automatic Headlights
- Delay-Off Headlights
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Speed Control
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Electronic Stability Control
- Traction Control

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine delivers 22 city and 31 highway miles per gallon, making this Escape an efficient choice for commuting and weekend travel. The six-speed automatic transmission provides smooth power delivery while maximizing fuel economy. All-wheel drive capability helps navigate various driving conditions with confidence.

Safety is prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. The electronic stability control and traction control systems work together to maintain control on challenging roads. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed of your tire condition.

Interior features enhance daily convenience and comfort. The SYNC system integrates your phone and audio preferences seamlessly. Automatic headlights and wipers respond to driving conditions without constant adjustment. The split folding rear seat creates flexible cargo configurations for whatever you're transporting.

The exterior parking camera rear gives you visibility when reversing, making parking and maneuvering simpler. Power windows, mirrors, and steering combine with the telescoping wheel to let every driver find an ideal driving position. The orange exterior color distinguishes this Escape with distinctive character on the road.

With 53,158 miles on the odometer, this Escape has been well-maintained and remains ready for years of dependable service. The combination of proven Ford engineering, practical features, and efficient performance makes this S model worth serious consideration for your next vehicle.

This 2016 Ford Flex SEL delivers practical three-row comfort and versatile styling in a distinctive blue exterior that stands out on the road.

- Memory Driver's Seat & Exterior Mirrors
- Power Liftgate
- BLIS Blind Spot Monitoring System with cross-traffic alert
- Premium 7-Speaker Audio System
- 6 passenger seating with 2nd Row 40/40 Reclining Seats
- Power Converter 110V Outlet
- Roof Rack Side Rails
- Heated leather-trimmed front bucket seats
- SYNC 3 with emergency communication system
- Exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear zones
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel
- 20" painted high gloss black wheels
- Telescoping steering wheel with audio controls
- Speed-sensitive wipers

The 3.5L V6 Ti-VCT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides reliable power for your daily drive, delivering 16 city and 23 highway mpg. The front-wheel-drive setup ensures confident handling while the four-wheel independent suspension contributes to a smooth, composed ride suitable for both highway cruising and city navigation.

Inside, the Flex SEL prioritizes comfort and functionality. The spacious cabin accommodates six passengers across three rows, with second-row seats that recline to accommodate your specific comfort needs. Heated leather-trimmed seats provide warmth during colder months, while the automatic dual-zone climate control ensures both front and rear passengers enjoy their preferred temperature settings. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and memory driver's seat adjust to your preferences automatically each time you enter the vehicle.

Technology keeps you connected and informed throughout your journey. SYNC 3 audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio, CD player, and steering wheel-mounted controls simplifies operation. The exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors take the guesswork out of backing up, while the BLIS blind spot monitoring system and cross-traffic alert add confidence to lane changes and reversing maneuvers.

Practical features enhance daily convenience and safety. The power liftgate opens and closes at the touch of a button, the power converter 110V outlet lets you charge devices on the go, and roof rack side rails accommodate cargo carriers for additional storage. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants, while the low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about your vehicle's condition.

The Appearance Package elevates the Flex's distinctive styling with shadow black painted details including the roof, grille center bar, and door mirror caps. The 20" painted high gloss black wheels complement this purposeful aesthetic, while unique finish touches on the door trim and instrument panel add personality to the cabin.

This Flex SEL represents practical family transportation with the reliability and capability you need for your lifestyle. Visit our showroom to experience the comfortable seating, intuitive controls, and smart storage solutions that make this vehicle an excellent choice for your next vehicle.

This 2016 Nissan Rogue SL offers a dependable and versatile option for drivers seeking a practical crossover with solid capability and comfort features.

- Roof rail cross bars
- Retractable cargo cover
- Chrome rear bumper protector
- Navigation System with NissanConnect
- Heated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- 18" alloy wheels
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Power liftgate
- Rear window defroster
- Multiple airbags including front center and overhead
- Traction control and electronic stability control
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Speed-sensing steering

This Rogue combines functionality with everyday practicality. The 2.5L four-cylinder engine delivers consistent performance while the CVT transmission with Xtronic technology provides smooth acceleration and efficient fuel economy, achieving 25 mpg in the city and 32 mpg on the highway. All-wheel drive ensures confident traction across varying driving conditions, while the suspension system balances comfort with responsive handling.

The interior prioritizes comfort and convenience. Heated front bucket seats with leather appointment create an inviting cabin environment, while the front dual zone automatic climate control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. The power driver seat enables personalized positioning, and the telescoping steering wheel facilitates easy adjustment for different drivers.

Technology features enhance both safety and connectivity. The NissanConnect navigation system with AM/FM/CD/RDS/AUX capability keeps you informed of your route and entertained with SiriusXM satellite radio through nine speakers. Steering wheel mounted audio controls allow command of functions without taking your hands from the wheel, and the outside temperature display provides practical information at a glance.

Safety receives notable attention throughout the design. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work cohesively to maintain vehicle control. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and low tire pressure warning systems provide additional assurance, while the emergency communication system offers added peace of mind.

Cargo management is straightforward with the power liftgate, retractable cargo cover, and roof rail cross bars for additional storage capacity. The split folding rear seat expands versatility for larger items, while floor mats and a two-piece cargo area protector help maintain the interior's condition through daily use.

This 2016 Nissan Rogue SL represents solid transportation with a well-rounded feature set suited for everyday driving needs.

This 2016 Honda Pilot EX-L in white offers the spacious, versatile capability that families and professionals depend on for everyday driving and adventure.

- Leather-trimmed front bucket seats with heating and power adjustment
- Power moonroof for enhanced open-air comfort
- Automatic dual-zone climate control with rear air conditioning
- Remote keyless entry and power liftgate for convenience
- 18-inch alloy wheels with all-season capability
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Telescoping tilt steering wheel with mounted audio controls
- Rear window defroster and speed-sensitive wipers

The 3.5-liter V6 engine with 24-valve technology combines responsive performance with practical efficiency, delivering 18 city and 26 highway miles per gallon. All-wheel drive provides secure traction in varying road conditions, while the six-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth, predictable acceleration. Four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections, and speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving needs for enhanced control whether navigating city streets or highway stretches.

The seven-speaker audio system pairs with SiriusXM satellite radio, offering access to hundreds of channels without signal limitations.

Safety features are comprehensive. The Pilot includes dual front and side airbags, an occupant sensing system, overhead airbags for the second and third rows, and emergency communication via HondaLink Assist. Electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, disc brakes at all four wheels, and low tire pressure warning work together to promote security during all driving conditions.

Practicality defines the Pilot's design. The power liftgate opens automatically, third-row seats fold flat to accommodate larger items, and the rear window wiper keeps visibility clear in all weather. A backup camera displays on the center screen during reversing, while the HomeLink transmitter lets you operate compatible garage doors directly from the dashboard. Telescoping steering adjusts to fit your driving position perfectly.

This vehicle combines three-row seating capacity with the driving dynamics and comfort features you expect from a well-appointed midsize SUV. With all-wheel drive security, a proven engine platform, and extensive convenience technology, the 2016 Pilot EX-L serves families seeking reliability and capability in a presentable package.

This 2016 Subaru Forester 2.5i Limited offers reliable performance and practical versatility for drivers seeking a capable compact SUV. Clean Carfax history and local trade-in status mean this vehicle has been well-maintained and is ready for its next owner.

- AWD system for confident traction in various driving conditions
- Subaru Starlink 7.0" Multimedia Plus System with integrated technology
- Heated front bucket seats with perforated leather-trimmed upholstery
- Power moonroof for added interior brightness and airflow
- Harman/Kardon 440W audio system with AM/FM radio and SiriusXM capability
- Rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers for enhanced visibility
- Exterior parking camera for convenient reverse maneuvering
- Automatic temperature control and rear window defroster
- Power driver seat, power liftgate, and fully automatic headlights
- Roof rack rails for cargo flexibility
- Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry
- Electronic stability control and traction control for safety
- Four-wheel independent suspension for a smooth driving experience
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags with overhead and knee airbags

The Forester delivers 24 miles per gallon in the city and 32 on the highway, providing reasonable efficiency for everyday driving. The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine with Lineartronic CVT transmission offers straightforward power delivery, while the all-wheel-drive system ensures dependable traction and stability throughout the year. The rear seat splits for folding, allowing flexibility in configuring cargo space when needed.

Inside, the Limited trim delivers genuine comfort and convenience. Heated front seats keep you warm during cooler months, while the leather-trimmed upholstery and front center armrest add a touch of refinement. The power-adjustable driver seat, telescoping steering wheel, and tilt steering column allow you to find an optimal driving position. Dual vanity mirrors, front reading lights, and an overhead console complete the interior experience.

Technology and connectivity integrate seamlessly with the Subaru Starlink system, providing audio controls right at the steering wheel. The SiriusXM radio keeps you entertained with satellite options, while the CD player and standard AM/FM radio cover traditional listening preferences. An emergency communication system via STARLINK adds an extra layer of peace of mind during your travels.

Safety systems include four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, an emergency communication system, a low tire pressure warning indicator, and occupant sensing airbags. The electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip during challenging driving situations. Front fog lights and fully automatic headlights improve visibility in poor conditions.

This Forester presents solid value for buyers who prioritize reliability, all-wheel-drive capability, and practical everyday usefulness. We welcome you to visit our showroom to inspect this vehicle and take it for a test drive.

This 2016 Jeep Cherokee Limited delivers reliable performance and refined comfort for drivers seeking a dependable midsize SUV.

- Luxury Group and Trailer Tow Group packages
- 3.2L V6 engine with 9-Speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability
- Premium leather-trimmed bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Bi-xenon high-intensity discharge headlamps
- Power liftgate with convenient opening and closing
- GPS navigation with SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link services
- Uconnect 8.4 touchscreen display with integrated voice command
- SiriusXM satellite radio with premium sound system
- Heated steering wheel and exterior mirrors with memory functions
- ParkView rear backup camera
- Power full sunroof
- Auxiliary transmission oil cooler and engine oil cooler for efficient operation
- Class III receiver hitch with trailer tow wiring harness
- 18 polished aluminum wheels

The Cherokee Limited comes equipped with a comprehensive suite of technology features designed to enhance your driving experience. The Uconnect 8.4 NAV system provides intuitive navigation and entertainment control, while SiriusXM Traffic keeps you informed of road conditions. The premium audio system with nine amplified speakers and subwoofer delivers quality sound throughout the cabin, and voice command functionality allows hands-free operation of key features.

Comfort and convenience are priorities in this vehicle. The premium leather-trimmed front bucket seats feature both heating and ventilation, ensuring comfort in any season. The heated steering wheel, power door mirrors with memory settings, and dual-zone automatic climate control provide personalized comfort for all occupants. Interior amenities include an auto-dimming rearview mirror, multiple reading lights, and a power sunroof that adds an open-air feel to the cabin.

For those towing needs, this Cherokee is well-equipped. The Trailer Tow Group includes a Class III receiver hitch, seven and four-pin wiring harness, and trailer tow wiring harness. The auxiliary transmission oil cooler helps maintain optimal engine temperatures during demanding driving conditions. These features make this vehicle a capable choice for recreational or work-related towing scenarios.

Safety and visibility are enhanced through multiple features. Bi-xenon high-intensity discharge headlamps provide superior illumination, complemented by front fog lights and automatically activated headlights. The ParkView rear backup camera assists with parking and reversing, while the electronic stability control, traction control, and comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants. The four-wheel disc brake system with ABS provides reliable stopping power.

With 20 city MPG and 28 highway MPG, the 4WD powertrain balances capability with reasonable efficiency. The 9-speed automatic transmission delivers smooth gear transitions, and the four-wheel independent suspension contributes to composed handling and a comfortable ride quality.

This Cherokee Limited represents solid midsize SUV ownership, combining capable all-wheel-drive performance with well-appointed interior features and proven reliability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand.

This 2016 Ford Explorer Sport delivers capable three-row seating and genuine utility for families and adventurers alike. Finished in Black with a commanding presence, this Sport model combines versatility with practical performance features designed for real-world driving.

The perforated leather-trimmed heated front seats provide both style and warmth during colder months. Rear passengers enjoy their own climate zone and reading lights, while the split-folding rear seat configuration adapts to your cargo needs. A rear center armrest keeps middle passengers comfortable on longer drives.

Safety is engineered throughout this three-row family vehicle. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide confident handling. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections while the speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions. A comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead protection.

The 4WD system and 3.5L V6 engine provide the capability to handle varied driving conditions. With city fuel economy of 16 MPG and highway efficiency of 22 MPG, this mid-size SUV balances performance and practicality. The automatic temperature control system maintains comfort regardless of season, while the rear air conditioning and defroster ensure all passengers stay comfortable.

Technology integrates naturally into daily driving through the SYNC system with MyFord Touch interface. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep attention focused on the road while the hands-free liftgate opens automatically when you approach with your key fob. The voice-activated navigation system eliminates distractions while helping you reach your destination efficiently.

Ownership means access to a well-equipped family vehicle that handles daily demands and weekend adventures. The Explorer Sport's platform has proven reliability, and this model carries forward the brand's commitment to capable SUV design. Whether navigating city streets or exploring rougher terrain, this vehicle provides the space, performance, and comfort your family deserves.

This 2016 Nissan Rogue SV offers a reliable crossover designed for families who value practicality and comfort in their daily driving.

- Retractable Cargo Cover
- SV Premium Package with Safety Shield Technologies
- Blind Spot Warning and Moving Object Detection
- AroundView Monitor for enhanced visibility
- Heated Seats and Heated Outside Mirrors
- Power Liftgate
- NissanConnect Navigation with 7" color touch screen
- SiriusXM Radio with Traffic and Travel Link
- Automatic Temperature Control with front dual zone A/C
- Power driver seat with telescoping steering wheel
- Remote keyless entry and HomeLink
- 17" aluminum alloy wheels
- Split folding rear seat

The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that maintains its appeal over time. Inside, the cloth seating with heating capability keeps occupants comfortable during colder months, while the power-adjustable driver's seat allows you to find your ideal driving position. The cabin features practical storage solutions including door bins, an overhead console, and front center armrest storage.

Technology plays an important role in your daily experience. The NissanConnect system provides navigation with voice guidance, SiriusXM radio access, and mobile app integration. The 7-inch color touch screen keeps controls within easy reach, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls minimize distractions. Siri Eyes Free connectivity brings smartphone integration to your driving experience.

Safety and awareness features include the AroundView Monitor, which provides a comprehensive view around the vehicle, and Blind Spot Warning to alert you to traffic in adjacent lanes. Moving object detection adds an extra layer of awareness. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with CVT transmission with Xtronic delivers balanced performance with 25 city and 32 highway MPG efficiency. All-wheel drive provides confidence in varied weather conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections while maintaining responsive handling.

Practical features make ownership straightforward. Floor mats protect your interior, splash guards shield against road debris, and the rear window wiper handles challenging weather. The power liftgate opens hands-free when your arms are full of groceries or packages.

This Rogue SV combines everyday reliability with thoughtful amenities that enhance your driving experience. We invite you to schedule a time to see it in person and take it for a test drive.
